blockingInputs.missing: Human reconciliation of immutable reference evidence; 250 individual source files match current manifest/lock
Direct authorization to launch existing editor and run named native import/material/mesh generation/save jobs
Hash-approved resolved pinned layout JSON, entrances/spawns/navigation/seed/asset and generator revisions, native scenery geometry
Exact registered reusable shell/fixed-fixture geometry and base layouts; sourceFloorYMetres; real native openings for unmeasured rooms and common spaces; no saved furniture or account snapshot
Approved metric terrain/route/heightfield, named travel endpoints, collision/slopes/cover and initialized real native Landscape templates; composition PNG is not terrain data
Resolved derivative recipes for terrain/beaches/bridges, near architecture, parks/amenities, street detail, frontages/utilities, Theatre grounds, refinery, circuit and retained square
Approved initialized non-externalized native templates with real brush/navigation/lighting data; bake/nav generation remain separately authorized
Chosen named neighborhood and dated approved reference set for each canonical area; full registered assets, material finishes and mobile-ready vegetation LODs
